s1_01.heard: Where could your IT skills take you?

s2_01.heard: The Japanese IT Pathway program prepares Cambodian IT students for professional careers in Japan

s2_02.heard: Over two years, students first focus on learning Japanese. then develop their IT skills through classes conducted in Japanese

s2_03.heard: along the way They practice communication Teamwork problem solving and the professional habits expected in Japanese workplaces.

s2_04.heard: our goal is not simply to help students pass a language test,

s2_05.heard: It is to help them become IT professionals who can communicate contribute to a team and continue growing in Japan.

s3_01.heard: This opportunity exists because the Cambodian government believes in the potential of its young people.

s3_02.heard: With financial support from the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, MPTC, This program makes specialized Japanese language and IT education accessible to students.

s3_03.heard: This is more than support for individual careers,

s3_04.heard: It reflects the government's hope that Cambodian students will gain international experience strength in their abilities, and contribute to Cambodia's future.

s3_05.heard: The government is investing in education because it believes your growth matters.

s3_06.heard: Your education is an investment in the future of Cambodia.

s4_01.heard: This government support gives you a valuable opportunity

s4_02.heard: Your university? your teachers. Next make and the government are working together to create an environment where you can learn and grow.

s4_03.heard: But there is one thing they cannot do for you.

s4_05.heard: Learning Japanese takes patience. Developing IT skills takes practice.
